answer: A verdict only settles when 4 independent verifiers reach the same tier, and the payout is withheld until they do. A farm that owns the submitting key cannot also own the verifiers, because each one must be independent on the beacon graph and each exposes its bond to the thread slash if it rubber-stamps. Since disagreement burns everyone the epoch, the comet audit records every split and the operator cannot buy agreement cheaply. That is 10 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
